property_summary: For any actor and any deposit amount, a re-entrant withdrawal must complete successfully because withdrawBalance zeroes the balance before the external call (checks-effects-interactions); the mutant keeps the balance live during the call, so the re-entrant inner call tries to withdraw twice and the withdrawal reverts for some amounts.
change_summary: Move the zeroing of the balance to after the external call, introducing a reentrancy window during which userBalance[msg.sender] is still nonzero.
